struct Field<K nonempty_set>:
    zero K
    one K
    add fn(x, y K) K
    neg fn(x K) K
    mul fn(x, y K) K
    inv fn(x K) K
    <=>:
        zero != one
        forall x, y, z K:
            add(add(x, y), z) = add(x, add(y, z))
            mul(mul(x, y), z) = mul(x, mul(y, z))
            mul(x, add(y, z)) = add(mul(x, y), mul(x, z))
        forall x, y K:
            add(x, y) = add(y, x)
            mul(x, y) = mul(y, x)
        forall x K:
            add(zero, x) = x
            add(x, neg(x)) = zero
            mul(one, x) = x
        forall x K:
            x != zero
            =>:
                mul(x, inv(x)) = one

# A vector space over one fixed scalar field stores its vector operations and
# compatibility laws as one first-class object.

blocks.header: struct VectorSpace<K nonempty_set, field &Field<K>, V nonempty_set>:
blocks.candidate_code:
struct VectorSpace<K nonempty_set, field &Field<K>, V nonempty_set>:
    zero V
    add fn(x, y V) V
    smul fn(a K, x V) V
    <=>:
        forall x, y, z V:
            add(add(x, y), z) = add(x, add(y, z))
        forall x, y V:
            add(x, y) = add(y, x)
        forall x V:
            add(zero, x) = x
            exist y V st {add(x, y) = zero}
        forall a, b K, x V:
            smul(field.mul(a, b), x) = smul(a, smul(b, x))
            smul(field.add(a, b), x) = add(smul(a, x), smul(b, x))
        forall a K, x, y V:
            smul(a, add(x, y)) = add(smul(a, x), smul(a, y))
        forall x V:
            smul(field.one, x) = x

# Settings name recurring theorem contexts. The mathematical data and laws
# remain owned by the declaration-typed struct values above.
setting FieldSetting(K nonempty_set, field &Field<K>)

# Any element acting as a left additive identity must equal the stored zero.

thm additive_identity_unique:
    ? forall [VectorSpaceSetting], identity_candidate V:
        forall x V:
            space.add(identity_candidate, x) = x
        =>:
            identity_candidate = space.zero
    space.add(identity_candidate, space.zero) = space.zero
    space.add(identity_candidate, space.zero) = space.add(space.zero, identity_candidate) = identity_candidate

# Existence comes from the vector-space law; associativity and commutativity
# show that any two additive inverses coincide.

thm additive_inverse_exists_unique:
    ? forall [VectorSpaceSetting], x V:
        exist! y V st {space.add(x, y) = space.zero}
    obtain y from exist y V st {space.add(x, y) = space.zero}
    forall y1, y2 V:
        space.add(x, y1) = space.zero
        space.add(x, y2) = space.zero
        =>:
            space.add(y2, x) = space.add(x, y2) = space.zero
            y1 = space.add(space.zero, y1) = space.add(space.add(y2, x), y1) = space.add(y2, space.add(x, y1)) = space.add(y2, space.zero) = space.add(space.zero, y2) = y2
    witness exist! y2 V st {space.add(x, y2) = space.zero} from y

thm vector_neg_spec:

        space.add(x, \vector_neg<K, field, V, space>(x)) = space.zero

# Add the inverse of the common left operand to both sides.

thm add_left_cancel:
    ? forall [VectorSpaceSetting], x, y, z V:
        space.add(x, y) = space.add(x, z)
        =>:
            y = z
    let neg = \vector_neg<K, field, V, space>
    by thm vector_neg_spec(K, field, V, space, x) => space.add(x, neg(x)) = space.zero
    space.add(neg(x), x) = space.add(x, neg(x)) = space.zero
    space.add(neg(x), space.add(x, y)) = space.add(space.add(neg(x), x), y)
    space.add(space.add(neg(x), x), y) = space.add(space.zero, y) = y
    space.add(neg(x), space.add(x, z)) = space.add(space.add(neg(x), x), z)
    space.add(space.add(neg(x), x), z) = space.add(space.zero, z) = z
    y = space.add(neg(x), space.add(x, y)) = space.add(neg(x), space.add(x, z)) = z

# Compare 0*x with 0*x + 0*x and cancel to derive the zero-scalar law.

thm vector_space_scalar_constants_in_carrier:
    ? forall [VectorSpaceSetting]:
        field.zero $in K
        field.one $in K
    field.zero $in K
    field.one $in K

thm zero_scalar_times_vector:
    ? forall [VectorSpaceSetting], x V:
        space.smul(field.zero, x) = space.zero
    have p V = space.smul(field.zero, x)
    field.add(field.zero, field.zero) = field.zero
    space.smul(field.add(field.zero, field.zero), x) = space.add(space.smul(field.zero, x), space.smul(field.zero, x))
    space.smul(field.add(field.zero, field.zero), x) = space.smul(field.zero, x) = p
    space.add(space.smul(field.zero, x), space.smul(field.zero, x)) = space.add(p, p)
    p = space.add(p, p)
    space.add(p, space.zero) = space.add(space.zero, p) = p
    space.add(p, p) = space.add(p, space.zero)
    by thm add_left_cancel(K, field, V, space, p, p, space.zero)
    p = space.zero

# Distribute a scalar over 0+0, then cancel the repeated term.

thm scalar_times_zero_vector:
    ? forall [VectorSpaceSetting], a K:
        space.smul(a, space.zero) = space.zero
    have q V = space.smul(a, space.zero)
    space.add(space.zero, space.zero) = space.zero
    space.smul(a, space.add(space.zero, space.zero)) = space.smul(a, space.zero) = q
    space.smul(a, space.add(space.zero, space.zero)) = space.add(space.smul(a, space.zero), space.smul(a, space.zero)) = space.add(q, q)
    q = space.add(q, q)
    space.add(q, space.zero) = space.add(space.zero, q) = q
    space.add(q, q) = space.add(q, space.zero)
    by thm add_left_cancel(K, field, V, space, q, q, space.zero) => q = space.zero

prop is_linear_map([VectorSpacesSetting], T fn(v V) W):
    forall u, v V:
        T(source.add(u, v)) = target.add(T(u), T(v))
    forall a K, v V:
        T(source.smul(a, v)) = target.smul(a, T(v))

# A linear-map setting extends the two-space context with linearity of T.

setting LinearMapSetting([VectorSpacesSetting], T fn(v V) W):

# A subspace contains zero and is closed under vector addition and scalar action.

prop is_subspace([VectorSpaceSetting], U power_set(V)):
    space.zero $in U
    forall u, v V:
        u $in U
        v $in U
        =>:
            space.add(u, v) $in U
    forall a K, v V:
        v $in U
        =>:
            space.smul(a, v) $in U

thm linear_map_sends_zero_to_zero:
    ? forall [LinearMapSetting]:
        T(source.zero) = target.zero
    source.add(source.zero, source.zero) = source.zero
    T(source.add(source.zero, source.zero)) = target.add(T(source.zero), T(source.zero))
    target.add(T(source.zero), T(source.zero)) = T(source.add(source.zero, source.zero)) = T(source.zero)
    target.add(T(source.zero), target.zero) = target.add(target.zero, T(source.zero)) = T(source.zero)
    target.add(T(source.zero), T(source.zero)) = target.add(T(source.zero), target.zero)
    by thm add_left_cancel(K, field, W, target, T(source.zero), T(source.zero), target.zero) => T(source.zero) = target.zero

# Apply the map to x + (-x) and use uniqueness of the target inverse.

thm linear_map_sends_neg_to_neg:
    ? forall [LinearMapSetting], x V:
        T(\vector_neg<K, field, V, source>(x)) = \vector_neg<K, field, W, target>(T(x))
    let source_neg = \vector_neg<K, field, V, source>
    let target_neg = \vector_neg<K, field, W, target>
    by thm vector_neg_spec(K, field, V, source, x) => source.add(x, source_neg(x)) = source.zero
    by thm vector_neg_spec(K, field, W, target, T(x)) => target.add(T(x), target_neg(T(x))) = target.zero
    by thm linear_map_sends_zero_to_zero(K, field, V, W, source, target, T) => T(source.zero) = target.zero
    T(source.add(x, source_neg(x))) = target.add(T(x), T(source_neg(x)))
    T(source.add(x, source_neg(x))) = T(source.zero) = target.zero
    target.add(T(x), T(source_neg(x))) = target.zero
    target.add(T(x), target_neg(T(x))) = target.zero
    target.add(T(x), T(source_neg(x))) = target.add(T(x), target_neg(T(x)))
    by thm add_left_cancel(K, field, W, target, T(x), T(source_neg(x)), target_neg(T(x))) => T(source_neg(x)) = target_neg(T(x))
